title: B-tree index, a rotary card file
label: Rotary card file: a double-rimmed spoked wheel on an A-frame stand over a six-drawer cabinet, ten open trays of tabbed index cards hanging level round its rim, a hex-nut crank, and the found row's drawer open.
caption: Move across the figure to pick a key: the wheel turns one tray, one page of the index, to the reading stop per level and the drawer holding that row slides out, so any key costs four reads, never a scan of every card.
